sources.title: Synthetic standard supplier guide
sources.text: For the UK standard supplier-activation process from 1 January 2026, Finance approves activation after due-diligence checks are complete. The supplier record stays on hold until approval is recorded. This guide does not define an emergency exception.

segments.text: The buyer requested a new supplier for a repair. Finance confirmed that the bank details matched. I noticed the insurance certificate had expired, so I kept the supplier on hold and asked the buyer for a renewed certificate. The supplier has not been activated.
Correction: I recorded the hold and the expired certificate in our procurement register, not in the ERP. The buyer can see that note. A valid certificate is required to lift the hold.
I do not remember the date.
I do not know who could find that date.
No other checks were required for this request. This is our usual route, not an exception.
